# Webify Bharat

Webify Bharat is a digital operations partner for Indian MSMEs (micro, small and medium enterprises).

## One-line definition
Webify Bharat builds the website, WhatsApp, UPI payment gateway and reporting that an Indian business owner controls — so Google, Maps and chat send customers at ₹0 per organic lead, instead of renting them from Justdial, IndiaMART, Zomato, Swiggy, Amazon, Flipkart or Meta ads.

## Who it is for
Kirana and retail stores, restaurants, cloud kitchens (single and multi outlet), clinics, tuition centres and schools, real-estate desks, and manufacturing SMEs in India. Family-run and GST-registered firms. Not only funded startups.

## City coverage
Dedicated pages for Indian state capitals and major UTs at /cities and /cities/[slug], including Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Jaipur, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Patna, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Thiruvananthapuram, Raipur, Ranchi, Dehradun, Shimla, Panaji, Amaravati, Dispur (Guwahati hub), Itanagar, Imphal, Shillong, Aizawl, Kohima, Agartala, Gangtok, Srinagar, Puducherry, Port Blair, Leh.

Each city page covers: major local industries going digital, Amazon/Flipkart fee pressure vs owned catalogue, cloud-kitchen and F&B direct ordering, and the owned stack (website, WhatsApp, UPI, GST-ready receipts).

## What we sell
- Website design and development (mobile-first, local SEO, Google Business Profile alignment)
- E-commerce and dealer portals on your domain (reduce marketplace commission)
- Payment gateway setup (UPI, cards, net-banking; Razorpay / Cashfree / PayU class gateways)
- WhatsApp Business API / inbox workflows (your number, no per-lead fee)
- Analytics and BI (enquiries, collections, INR weekly view)
- Bookkeeping and GST-friendly invoice workflows

## Pricing (INR, starting, incl. 18% GST)
- Launch ₹9,999 incl. GST — site, basic analytics, WhatsApp setup
- Growth ₹19,999 incl. GST — payments + WhatsApp automation + dashboard
- Command ₹39,999 incl. GST — BI, custom integrations, dedicated support
All listed package and e-commerce addon prices include 18% GST. Hosting and optional care are month-to-month after launch.

## Contrast
Renting: Justdial / IndiaMART lead packs, Amazon/Flipkart referral fees and ads, aggregator commission, paying Google/Meta for your own brand name.
Owning: your domain, your WhatsApp, your list. Organic enquiry cost = ₹0 extra per head. Ads and marketplaces optional.
